scene: Tired new parent caught mid-scroll at 2am, phone screen reflecting on face
environment: Dimly lit bedroom at night. Baby bassinet or cot visible at edge of frame. Scattered feeding supplies and baby items on nightstand.
subject: Nigerian woman in her late 20s or early 30s, visibly tired but relatable. Not styled — real postpartum body, natural hair or simple wrap.

wardrobe: Nursing bra or tank top, oversized t-shirt or night gown. Not styled for camera.
lighting: Phone screen as key practical light on face. Warm bedside lamp or nightlight as fill. Deep shadows elsewhere. Night scene.

Baby items reflect actual newborn needs

exclusions: No gradient blobs or floating mockups
